posts.body:
I'm using rpg maker for many years now and apparently I NEVER came into this situation before, which is wild.
I created a relatively big map - 50x50 tiles. For now everything is done in the rpg maker editor itself. Basically a blank map where I put 2 event npcs on tiles X35/Y15 and X45/Y15
I set my starting position to X1/Y15 and when I move my character to the right I see the events, get closer to them but never reach them - I can't move past X30, it's like there is some region restriction or a deactivated passability, but thats not the case. It's simply an empty map.
I have absolutely no idea whats going on, can somebody help me?
nevermind, I just changed the tileset to another one and then back and it worked again. Most likely some strange bug. Feel free to delete this thread instead, sorry.
